name: Bloom
description: A bright burst of citrus. Bloom opens with zesty lemon and crisp green apple, softened by juicy orange — clean, cheerful and easy to wear every day.
alt: SAHUMäRIO Bloom Eau de Parfum 50 ml bottle with a black label, among cream flowers and pearls in warm sunlight
scent_profile: Fresh, zesty and fruity, with a juicy sweetness

name: Dew Drop
description: Cool and clean, like morning water on fresh leaves. Dew Drop pairs crisp green apple with a fresh aquatic breeze for a light, airy scent that feels effortlessly refreshing.
alt: SAHUMäRIO Dew Drop oil-based perfume bottle
notes: Green Apple, Aqua (Aquatic) Accord, Fresh Notes
scent_profile: Cool, clean and crisp, with a juicy green edge
occasion: Everyday wear, daytime, summer, gym and travel

name: Lemon Breeze
description: A sunny burst of fruit. Lemon Breeze opens with zesty lemon and fresh lime, then softens into juicy pineapple, sweet peach and cool melon — bright, playful and full of summer.
alt: SAHUMäRIO Lemon Breeze Eau de Parfum 50 ml bottle surrounded by fresh lemon slices and mint leaves
notes: Lemon, Fresh Lime, Pineapple, Peach, Melon
scent_profile: Bright, juicy and tropical, with a zesty fresh opening

name: Morning Dew
description: Fresh air at first light. Morning Dew opens with sparkling lemon and citrus over juicy melon, pineapple and peach, then settles into cool ozone with a soft herbal, gently spicy warmth — clean, airy and quietly confident.
alt: SAHUMäRIO Morning Dew Eau de Parfum 50 ml bottle with a pale blue tint on a bright white background
notes: Lemon, Citrus, Melon, Pineapple, Peach, Herbal Notes, Spice, Ozone
scent_profile: Airy, crisp and fruity, with a herbal, gently spicy finish
occasion: Everyday wear, office, mornings, all seasons

name: Night Queen
description: Clean, soft musk with subtle floral notes.
alt: SAHUMäRIO Night Queen Eau de Parfum 50 ml bottle with a navy label on a soft white background

name: Blix
alt: SAHUMäRIO Blix Eau de Parfum 50 ml bottle with a light green tint on a bright white background
